where: Stillwater, the Hollowing's village north of the Coldfog marshes: shuttered lamps, soft voices, kin asleep under grey blankets
mood: A hush-hymn: a music-box with a felt damper, sung softly by tired, kind people who believe the dark is mercy.
_motif_note: low: a drained place (house rule), so the shared lullaby is only a ghost under it; written at 90 BPM because conditioning locks the take to the motif's ~90 grid (the classic chip render runs at 72).
core_styles: retro sampled-chip instruments with the soft echo of a 16-bit sound chip
3/4 time, a slow rocking hymn pulse
D minor, turning to B-flat major for a hymn
a soft muted music box with a felt damper carrying the melody
a quiet pulse-wave lead doubling the music box
a hushed sampled string pad holding hymn chords
a low soft bass note on each bar
very quiet and tender, a whispering village where kin sleep

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a single muted music-box phrase in D minor over a soft held string chord, like a lid opened very gently}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {a muted music box and soft pulse lead: a lift from the fifth to the tonic and up a step, then a falling settle, each phrase hanging on the second degree over a suspended chord}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the hymn again, a step higher and then falling back, the strings a little warmer, the music box still felt-damped and quiet}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {the hall's hymn: the tune turns to B-flat major, a gentle sung rest, soft harp arpeggios breathing beneath for the first time, sincere and consoling, then turning back to a suspended A chord}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the hush-hymn returns in D minor, quiet and steady; the last bar hangs on the second degree and lifts straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
